decisions.reason: A hearty bread close to the core assortment costs little to keep in production, and with no negative evidence the option remains worth holding.
The sweet pastry uses existing craft skills and equipment, so its carrying cost is low, and its value is not yet disproven.
The farmhouse bread is a low-cost extension of the established bread range, and its recent launch leaves its prospects still open.
The gold award and flagship positioning have largely resolved the uncertainty in its favour, which justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
The gold-awarded premium stollen shows realized quality value in a profitable seasonal niche at low marginal cost.
